title: Spider-Man and The Odyssey are splitting up IMAX screens after a record-breaking weekend
summary: Spider-Man: Brand New Day is joining The Odyssey in IMAX theaters after both movies led the biggest weekend in box office history. IMAX says The Odyssey is the only film that has driven “multiple $40 million-plus weekends” in its global box office.
